test_title: PYST 6: DP Head Constable (AWO/TPO) 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 28 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Each of the seven friends, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R has a different age. R is older than L. L is older than M. N is the eldest. Only two persons are older than Q. O is not the youngest. Only one person is younger than M. How many persons are older than R?
solution:
**Given: **Each of the seven friends, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R has a different age.

R is older than L. L is older than M.

→ R > L > M.

 Only two persons are older than Q. Only one person is younger than M
